messages.author: 889f8cd3d22a06b8
messages.subject: viewport grid layout
parts:
I am using ggplot2's grid layout in viewport to plot multiple residual
and predicted-vs-observed plots on one page. I am trying to gain
space for the plots by removing axis labels and tick labels by setting
them to NULL or "", but have not been able to get the plot area to
expand into the space formerly occupied by labels. Any suggestions?
Code below.

## Observed vs. predicted
## Plot six to a page
dev.new()
theme_set(theme_bw());
theme_update(theme_text(size = 11, vjust = 0.0, colour = "black"));
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(3, 2)))
print(O1 + geom_line(aes(x=TSS_obs, y=TSS_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=0.5,
y=3.8), label="a) TSS", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1,
layout.pos.col = 1) )
print(O2 + geom_line(aes(x=TOC_obs, y=TOC_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=2.7,
y=3.9), label="b) TOC", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1,
layout.pos.col = 2) )
print(O3 + geom_line(aes(x=DOC_obs, y=DOC_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=2.7,
y=3.9), label="c) DOC", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 2,
layout.pos.col = 1) )
print(O4 + geom_line(aes(x=TN_obs, y=TN_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=0.46,
y=0.95), label="d) TN", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 2,
layout.pos.col = 2) )
print(O5 + geom_line(aes(x=DON_obs, y=DON_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=0.3,
y=0.93), label="f) DON", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 3,
layout.pos.col = 1) )
print(O6 + geom_line(aes(x=DON_obs, y=NH4_obs)) + geom_text(aes(x=0.3,
y=0.93), label="f) DON", size = 4), vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 3,
layout.pos.col = 1) )

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: viewport grid layout
parts:
Hi,

You can play with the theme settings using opts(),


library(ggplot2)

p = qplot(1:10,1:10)

snug.opts <- opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank(),
axis.title.x = theme_blank(),
axis.title.y = theme_blank(),
axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "lines"),
axis.ticks.margin = unit(0, "lines"),
panel.margin = unit(0, "lines"),
plot.margin = unit(c(-0.5,0,0,-0.5), "lines"))

fourplots <- replicate(4, p + snug.opts, simplify=FALSE)

library(gridExtra)

do.call(grid.arrange, fourplots)


HTH,

baptiste
